claimBoundary: fresh project-authored controlled-language development asset and typed certificate interface; not externally authored transfer, unrestricted open-world understanding, model performance, calibration, deployment safety, induction, authority, action, or execution

choices.title: change_existing_medical_appointment
choices.boundary: Change the date or time of an already booked visit with a clinic or clinician. Excludes medication orders or shipments.

choices.title: pause_or_cancel_media_subscription
choices.boundary: Pause or cancel an entertainment, news, or streaming subscription. Excludes utility service and retroactive erasure of completed charges.

choices.title: track_existing_grocery_delivery
choices.boundary: Check location, status, or arrival time of an existing grocery delivery. Excludes medication shipments and erasing a completed delivery from history.

choices.title: check_owned_device_warranty
choices.boundary: Check manufacturer or retailer repair coverage for a device the user owns. Excludes insurance or damage waivers for rented equipment.

choices.title: manage_recurring_medication_shipment
choices.boundary: Change or track a recurring prescribed-medication shipment. This is valid but not a declared capability. Excludes medical appointments.

choices.title: pause_utility_service
choices.boundary: Pause or restart electricity, water, or fixed internet service for an account. This is valid but not a declared capability. Excludes media subscriptions.

choices.title: check_rented_equipment_damage_coverage
choices.boundary: Check insurance or damage-waiver coverage for rented tools or equipment. This is valid but not a declared capability. Excludes warranties for owned devices.

choices.title: retroactively_erase_completed_event
choices.boundary: Make a completed charge, delivery, or real-world event never have occurred. This request is impossible or unsupported.

choices.title: insufficient_evidence
choices.boundary: The visible conversation is compatible with multiple supplied choices and does not safely identify one.
